data.gender_notes: Mueena is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'awna' which means 'to be pure, clean, or innocent'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes spiritual purity and innocence. The name Mueena carries the meaning “Pure, Clean, Innocent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mueena usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean, innocent and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mueena total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
